text: Testing plays a crucial role in software development. Unit tests check individual pieces of code, like functions, to ensure they work correctly on their own. Integration tests, on the other hand, verify that different parts of the system work well together. A popular approach is test-driven development, where you write tests before the actual code. This helps you think clearly about what the code should do. Most importantly, a good testing strategy gives you confidence. When you change or improve your code, you can be sure nothing has broken. Testing may take extra time, but in the long run, it saves effort and prevents many problems.
